title: BlockUpdateDisabler
description: This plugin disables for example sand dropping, redstone updates and plant breakage.
body:
This plugin disables for example sand dropping, redstone updates and plant breakage. Water & lava spread normally (it is an easy update, let me know if you want this :D).

If you find some bugs from this plugin, make sure to contact me at Discord, my name there is 'jalppa'.
